measured_cause: Repeated immutable generated property shapes and RDF value lists cause dominant recursive meta-SHACL validation and diagnostic-formatting cost. Dataset preparation and shape construction are not the dominant costs.

default_scope_finding.reason: Two external records have field:definition, field:label and field:module in the external named graph. Original default asserted+derived validation generates targets for them without selecting their metadata. Generated and contract shapes each report the three missing fields.
default_scope_finding.host_action: Host owns the default authoring scope correction; explicit graph selection and inferred exclusion remain preserved.

limits.guarded_owner_dispatch: Integrated host acceptance remains required; this bounded worker does not dispatch owners.
